text:
Trading Signals

 

 17 triggers. 44 algorithms. 3 AI experts. Every signal backed by causal reasoning and verified against real prices. 

Live crypto trading signals for Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, Windsurf & 30+ AI agents. Every signal comes with its reasoning — a transmission chain showing exactly which data points led to the trade — and is verified against real prices. Pro adds the trade levels: entry, stop-loss, take-profit, leverage and position size. See Pricing.

Updates, new features and how-tos: follow @x70signals on X.

 Install

 Claude Code Plugin (recommended)

 

 npx (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.)

 

 MCP Server (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Codex)

 Sign in from your agent (recommended). Add the URL below and your client opens a browser page where you sign in or create a free account — 14 days of Pro, no card — and click Allow . No key to copy.

 Claude Code 

 

 Claude app (Desktop & claude.ai) — Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector , URL 

 Cursor ( /.cursor/mcp.json )

 

 Try it without an account: use instead — 3 live signals plus the verified hit rate. When you ask for more, your client offers to sign in.

 With an API key (Codex, scripts, clients that can't sign in) — get a free key at the API Key page has copy-paste setup for every client.

 

Claude app with a key: (connectors have no header field).

 Codex ( /.codex/config.toml , key in env var SIGNALS API KEY )

 

Tools: get signals , get signal , get signal history , get stats ( register is deprecated — keys come from the dashboard).

 OpenAI Codex CLI

See agents/openai.yaml for agent configuration.

 Manual

 

 Always Watching

 17 Triggers. 6 Groups. Every Minute. 

The sentinel continuously scans 50+ perpetual markets for anomalies across six orthogonal dimensions -- volume, positioning, price dynamics, cross-asset flows, microstructure, and options-derived signals. A signal fires only when multiple independent dimensions agree, filtering noise from genuine opportunities.

 Multi-Expert Consensus

Three specialized AI experts analyze every opportunity independently -- each with a different lens on market structure. Signals require agreement; conflicting views are flagged or filtered. The system continuously learns which analytical approaches perform best per market condition.

 Research-Grounded

 44 Scientific Methods. 53 Academic Citations. 

Every algorithm is grounded in peer-reviewed research from quantitative finance, statistics, and machine learning -- spanning position sizing, anomaly detection, technical analysis, market microstructure, and adaptive risk management.

 What You Get

 Feature Description 
 --------- ------------- 
 Live signals Bullish/bearish with reasoning on every plan; the trade setup (entry, SL, TP, leverage, position size) is Pro-only 
 Transmission chains 2-4 causal reasoning steps per signal with specific data points 
 50+ coins Dynamically selected from top volume, funding, and OI on Hyperliquid perps 
 Confidence score 0-100: the model's own conviction per signal (not a calibrated probability) 
 Auto-verification Every signal tracked against real prices -- TP/SL monitoring every minute 
 Paper trading P&L Paper trades on a virtual account: every signal as a simulated position, fees included 
 Dynamic risk control Confidence-based leverage caps, volatility-calibrated SL, automatic regime detection 
 Performance stats Hit rate, cumulative ROI, profit factor, breakdown by direction/coin/model 

 Signal Preview

Example rows — not live data. Entry, SL, TP and leverage are returned on Pro; the free plan returns coin, direction, confidence and the reasoning.

 Coin Dir Conf Entry SL TP Lev R/R Type 
 ------ ----- ------ ------- ---- ---- ----- ----- ------ 
 BTC Bull 87% $68,450 $67,200 $71,800 3x 2.7 momentum shift 
 ETH Bear 82% $3,840 $3,920 $3,680 2x 2.0 funding anomaly 
 SOL Bull 79% $142.50 $138.00 $152.00 2x 2.1 volume spike 

 API Endpoints

 Method Path Auth Description 
 -------- ------ ------ ------------- 
 POST /api/skill/register No Deprecated — returns signup required ; get keys at /mcp-signup 
 GET /api/skill/signals API key List signals (active/verified/all) 
 GET /api/skill/signals/:id API key Single signal detail 
 GET /api/skill/stats API key Performance statistics 

 Example Prompts

Once installed, ask your AI agent:

- "Get me the latest crypto trading signals" 
- "Show me today's highest-confidence BTC and ETH signals" 
- "What's the 30-day hit rate for these trading signals?" 
- "Build me a Python script that fetches crypto signals and alerts me on Telegram" 
- "Show me verified signals from the last week -- what hit TP?" 

 Track record

October 2026, every signal we published, losses included:

 

1,595 signals: 74.7% hit their target or closed in profit, +1.41% per signal on average after fees and without leverage; 401 lost. Almost all were shorts in a month BTC fell 7.3%, so this is a falling-market result. We post rally months the same way. Per signal: the target or stop when hit, else the close, minus 0.12% fees. Past results don't guarantee future results.

 Paper-trade it first

Want to see how the signals do before you trade them? Let your agent run the paper-trading bot on your machine. It takes each new signal as a $100 paper position at the live price, charges fees on both sides, and logs every trade, wins and losses, to a CSV you own. No real orders, no exchange account; one Python file, standard library only.

The API Key page has a ready prompt for Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, with your key filled in. Our own copy has been running since Oct 7: its live record.

 Rate limit 30 calls/hour per IP 300 calls/hour 10,000 calls/hour 
 Price free free $35/

install.title: Install
install.html:
Claude Code Plugin (recommended)
/plugin marketplace add roman-rr/trading-skills
/plugin install trading-skills@trading-skills
npx (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.)
npx skills add roman-rr/trading-skills
MCP Server (Claude, Cursor, VS Code, Codex)

Sign in from your agent (recommended). Add the URL below and your client opens a browser page where you sign in or create a free account — 14 days of Pro, no card — and click Allow. No key to copy.

Claude Code

claude mcp add --transport http trading-signals https://signals.x70.ai/mcp/connect
# then in Claude Code: /mcp → trading-signals → Authenticate

Claude app (Desktop & claude.ai) — Customize → Connectors → Add custom connector, URL https://signals.x70.ai/mcp/connect.

Cursor (~/.cursor/mcp.json)

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "trading-signals": { "url": "https://signals.x70.ai/mcp/connect" }
  }
}

Try it without an account: use https://signals.x70.ai/mcp instead — 3 live signals plus the verified hit rate. When you ask for more, your client offers to sign in.

With an API key (Codex, scripts, clients that can't sign in) — get a free key at https://signals.x70.ai/mcp-signup?utm_content=github-readme; the API Key page has copy-paste setup for every client.

claude mcp add --transport http trading-signals https://signals.x70.ai/mcp --header "X-Api-Key: YOUR_KEY"

Claude app with a key: https://signals.x70.ai/mcp?apiKey=YOUR_KEY (connectors have no header field).

Codex (~/.codex/config.toml, key in env var SIGNALS_API_KEY)

[mcp_servers.trading-signals]
url = "https://signals.x70.ai/mcp"
bearer_token_env_var = "SIGNALS_API_KEY"

Tools: get_signals, get_signal, get_signal_history, get_stats (register is deprecated — keys come from the dashboard).

OpenAI Codex CLI

See agents/openai.yaml for agent configuration.

Manual
# Claude Code
git clone https://github.com/roman-rr/trading-skills.git
cp -r trading-skills/trading-signals ~/.claude/skills/trading-signals

# OpenAI Codex CLI
cp -r trading-skills/trading-signals ~/.codex/skills/trading-signals
